notes.title: Update 1.5 - Voice Control Activated
notes.notes:
Greetings captains,

Your neural link to the battlefield has been upgraded! Now when you raise your wrist to view the Hand Menu, you'll be able to issue commands to your fighting vessels using your voice*.  We've also revamped the menu to improve the ship display and made each section collapsible to let you streamline the Hand Menu to your liking. The Hand Menu can now be locked in place and repositioned as well so that you can continue to issue voice commands without keeping your hand raised.

[Check out the voice command trailer here ](https://youtu.be/XSI6DmDoVks)

All ships will now have a designation you can use when issuing commands. Friendly ships will use the color green (and a number) and enemy ships will be red. So if you want to order a friendly ship to attack an enemy, you'll say something like "Green 3 attack Red 2!" Ships can be ordered individually or as a group by saying "All ships" or "all fighters". In addition to attack commands you can order ships to enter formation by saying "Green 1 follow Flagship" or "Green 2 defend green 3". Voice commands can also be combined with hand gestures. You can say "Green 6, move here" and the ship will move to the spot indicated by your right hand. Saying "Flagship, attack this" will order the flagship to attack whatever ship your hand is currently touching - useful if your Flagship is out of reach or far away.

In addition to attacking, defending and moving, you also have access to issue the following voice commands:

* **Use systems** - For example: "Flagship, deploy Fusion Beam" or when you really want to do maximum damage say: "Green 3 fire everything!" to use all offensive items on your current target.
* **Retreat** - Order a strategic withdrawal by saying "Green 2 retreat". Ships will use any equipped defensive systems such as "Fold" or "Shell" to help them escape.
* **Find a ship** - say "Show Red 2" to jump to that ship's position
* **Target specific systems** - Say "Target Red 3's engines" to set your fleet's focus for this ship.
* **Recall your fighters** - Say "Fighters, form up" to have them return to defending your flagship.

Voice commands take your immersion to the next level. They're also great to use when a ship is beyond your reach or for multitasking when combined with using your hands or controllers.

Be sure to check out the full list of voice commands using the list on your Hand Menu or in your flagship Infopedia. There are additional commands when on board your ship. Voice commands are provided using the official Meta Voice SDK.

* Note: Voice commands are currently only available to English language users. Voice commands are optional and can be fully disabled in game.

notes.title: The Endless Mode update is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34065862/420ecaef345e6c126d4aa54d6a907ccd525a1629.gif[/img]

The Endless Mode update is rolling out today. It adds a brand new, fully procedural campaign with 5 flagships for you to take command of as you embark on your quest to reach the alien structure known as The Center. We've heard your feedback and we think players will appreciate the longer campaign, with more variety and more freedom to customize and grow your fleet. We've made optimizations so that battles can include more ships and we've made Permadeath optional in Easy and Medium mode to make it a less frustrating experience for those that found the game too challenging. For those that want more challenge, we've added modifiers to endless mode so you can choose to play with modified rules, such as only being able to repair at stores, or having a chance for systems to be permanently destroyed in battle. We've added a new resource to the game called Scrap, which will be used to repair your fleets. This change was made because some found it difficult to maintain their fleets and have enough money left over to upgrade them. Scrap makes it possible to do both.

Endless mode is a scored mode with your multiplier determined by your difficulty settings. We've added a leaderboard for Endless Mode, and also leaderboards for number of wins in the regular "Story" mode. We've also added 5 new challenge missions to the Skirmish menu, and plan to add more in the future. Almost every part of the game has seen updates in this release: 

[list]
[*] Graphical improvements & new effects
[*] Balance changes
[*] Bug fixes
[*] New ships
[*] New items 
[*] New and improved space environments
[*] New space obstacle placement algorithm
[*] More!
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the update - If you do, we'd love it if you left us a review. If you encounter any bugs, they can be reported on our discord (https://discord.gg/NbZgQeuwc8) or send us an email on our website (https://www.starlight-vr.com/). Good luck out there!

notes.title: Eternal Starlight 1.3 BETA available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34065862/697974f12b316e034b8c90b6bdb2d159952ec287.jpg[/img]

A beta version for [b]Eternal Starlight 1.3 (the Endless Mode update)[/b] is available on the Beta channel. This version doesn't yet have the full set of translations and may still see a few tweaks and fixes before launch, but players are welcome to start checking it out. This is our biggest update yet and features tons of new features. The biggest addition: The new Endless Mode, which is a fully procedural campaign with randomized fleets and missions with new options to tailor the experience to your liking. There are 5 flagships to unlock and play, including the new Entirrizi flagship. 

[h2]Other big updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Permadeath is now optional in all modes (except Hard difficulty)
[*] Updated ship art & effects
[*] Revamped items and balance changes
[*] 5 new skirmish Challenge missions
[*] New Leaderboards and Achievements
[*] New items & vessels
[*] New environments
[*] New Resource: Scrap, for repairs
[*] Optimizations and other improvements
[*] Much more!
[/list]

notes.title: New languages & bHaptics support
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 of Eternal Starlight is now available, adding new language support for German, French, Spanish, Korean and Japanese. This version also adds bHaptics support (Tactsuit X40, Tactosy for arms, Tactal for head) so you can truly feel all those explosions. 

Also in this update:

[list]
[*] Beam damage calculation bugfixes, and balance changes to beam items for better progression
[*] Increased max points for skirmish mode to 15
[*] Added DPS to item info display for easier comparisions
[*] Buffed EM Nova item (increased damage)
[*] Nicer text reveal effect, added skip to outro and updated outro text
[*] Bugfixes on the tutorial and final mission
[/list]

The next version, 1.3, will feature some larger content updates. We will be adding "Challenges" to the skirmish mode which are more pre-defined missions for you to complete featuring some matchups that you wouldn't get in the single player campaign. We will also be adding leader boards and the new Endless mode. Endless mode will feature a more traditional roguelike experience with procedural missions, less dialogue, and more options for tailoring your run (more starting ship choices and difficulty modifiers).

notes.title: Eternal Starlight is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34065862/a0edb2feb530cb4b21d06fbc2202d7c5bec2fda1.gif[/img]

We started development back in 2016 for the HTC Vive. And now, Eternal Starlight has finally arrived with support for all Steam VR headsets. ES offers a unique experience for fans of sci-fi and strategy / tactics games. This is just the beginning - more updates to come! Drop by our community forum and let us know what you think.
